latest.title: Curvature Diffusion of Inverse-weight Lin--Lu--Yau Ricci Flow on Finite Trees
latest.abstract: We study the continuous Lin--Lu--Yau Ricci flow on a finite tree in the inverse-weight case. We investigate the diffusive structure of the curvature evolution equation and prove the convergence of the curvature along the Ricci flow. Moreover, we show that, in logarithmic coordinates, the Ricci flow can be characterized as the gradient flow of a convex potential.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 分析有限树上逆权重 Lin–Lu–Yau Ricci 流，证明曲率收敛，并在对数坐标下识别其为凸势的梯度流。
latest.breakthrough: 把离散曲率流的动力学转化为凸性机制，为理解收敛提供结构解释。
latest.limitations: 曲率收敛不等于所有归一化边权收敛；凸势可能不具强制性，边权比的收敛需额外谱隙和边界耦合条件。结论仍限有限树与逆权重。
latest.aiEvidence: Codex GPT-5.6 Sol 辅助英文与 LaTeX 编辑、文章组织、证明表述讨论及计算初检；作者核验数学内容。
latest.priorityReason: 曲率流与凸变分结构相关，技术可借鉴，但必须保留离散模型范围。
